snippet.title: Cash Cleaner Simulator — Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming to PC on May 8th and to consoles later in 2025. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488370/Cash_Cleaner_Simulator/

Check it, clean it, sort it, ship it. Welcome to the life of a cash cleaner. Take jobs from the Mob and use your cut to upgrade your crib. Just don't try to leave…

Join our official discord for more news!
http://discord.com/invite/YjTbXnTpct
